title: Dependency declared with an implausibly large major
description: package.json declares a major version far larger than any the project has published. Dependency-confusion and typosquat campaigns publish inflated versions so a permissive range resolves to them; the pin is what makes that possible.
remediation: Pin the version that the project actually tested against its registry.
limitation: It matches a major version far larger than any the project has published in the parsed package.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
